messages:
Maria Chen: 🎉 Quick heads-up — FrostByte shipped their DeepConnect ISV integration today. They built a connector using the Redwood SDK that lets customers embed streaming insights directly into their app. Listing goes live in the marketplace at 10:00 PT. link: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/frostbyte :tada:
Jon Liao: Amazing! big congrats to the partner team. Any notes on which models/config they recommend?
Priya Patel: They tested with rwd-3-small and a quantized rwd-2 for embeddings. Found best cost/latency with batch_size=8 and prefix caching on.
Samir Gupta: Nice — does FrostByte want a co-marketing case study? I can schedule a quick interview next week.
Maria Chen: Yes please, Samir. Priya can you run a short perf/latency capture for the case study? Need 95th pct latency and cost-per-embed numbers.
Priya Patel: On it. I’ll drop results in the drive folder and tag @marketing.
Jon Liao: Also pinging @sales — good chance for an AE upsell into a mid-market bundle.
Samir Gupta: I’ll coordinate with Solutions to offer a starter pack (2 mo discounted Dedicated trial) as part of the onboarding flow.
deploy-bot: marketplace-listing: FrostByte DeepConnect ISV entry deployed by @deploy-bot at 1849004325. status: LIVE. url: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/frostbyte
Maria Chen: Love it — team, please add any promo assets to the partnership drive. Small ask: keep quotes short and production-ready for the landing page.
Jon Liao: Will prepare a one-liner and a short tech blurb.
Priya Patel: Uploading perf screenshots now.
Samir Gupta: I’ll draft the case study outline and share a Google doc.
Maria Chen: Awesome. Huge win for ISV integrations — thanks everyone :rocket:
